title: Nightwave Plaza
lede: An online vaporwave radio whose player is a Windows 9x desktop over a faded anime still of stacked CRT computers.
summary: Windows 9x player windows and taskbar over a muted pink-and-teal anime still of old computers.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Clear: the site calls itself “Online Vaporwave Radio”, and it combines Windows 9x chrome with a faded 1980s-style anime image in dusty pink and teal. The CSS bevels pass the shadow and radius metrics.

observed: The background is a muted anime still of stacked beige computer units and CRT monitors, one labelled TOSHIBA EX-500, with orange, pink, and teal screens showing large pixel characters.
A grey Windows 9x player window with Play and like buttons and a pink checkered album thumbnail sits in the centre, partly covered by a News dialog with a navy title bar and a Close button.
A grey Windows 9x taskbar runs along the bottom with task buttons and a clock.
interpretation: The measurement finds hard shadows on 56% of boxes with a 1.4 px median offset and zero radius: the same bevel values as [Agora Road](ref:agora-road-website). The pastel colour is all in the background image, so gradient share is 0.
borrow: Put a faded, low-contrast image behind crisp, unfaded Windows 9x windows; the contrast between the two keeps the text readable.
